text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Ruka and Ninon are enjoying a friendly chat as they progress
through the tower.
The conversation eventually turns to their respective guilds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
塔を進む最中、雑談に興じるルカとニノン。
やがて話題は互いの所属ギルドにおよぶ。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Your guild, what was it again? ...Oh right, Toast Caramel!
I heard it's a very, very famous guild!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アネゴのギルド、
たしか
……
そう、
トーストキャラメル！
ベリーベリー有名なギルドと聞いてマース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
We don't sound that delicious, do we?It's \"Twilight Caravan.\"
Well, I wouldn't say we're famous.
I think infamous would be more fitting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだいその美味しそうなギルドは。
【トワイライトキャラバン】だよ。
まあ、
有名は有名でも
悪名の方かもしれないけどね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You see, we have \"The Destroyer,\" \"The Collector,\" \"The One-Eyed
Demon,\" and \"The Living Storm\" in our ranks. We're a motley crew of
interesting types with even more interesting nicknames.
choice_data_list: Being the master of a guild like that's pretty amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにしろ
『壊し屋』
『蒐集家』
『隻眼の悪魔』
『歩く竜巻』
なんて
物騒な二つ名で呼ばれてる連中の集まりだからね。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: That's right! Samurai Master really is spectacular!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通りデス！　
サムライマスターは
伊達じゃないデース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going with the flow.
Besides, while they may have their quirks, they're not at all bad guys.
text_block_list.orig_text:
成り行きでやってるだけさ。
それに
あいつらもクセは強いが、
決して悪いやつらじゃないしね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: As long as I [i]make[/i] them listen to me, they'll do exactly as I say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃ～んと言い聞かせてやれば、
言うこときいてくれるからねぇ？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Eeek! J-just now, I felt a sudden chill go down my spine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！　
い、
今
一瞬、
背筋がヒヤーっとしたデース……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
So, how about your guild? I heard on the grapevine that the
guildmaster of Weissflügel's a remarkable swordswoman.
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
アンタのとこはどうなんだい？　
ヴァイスフリューゲルって
ギルドマスターが
凄腕の剣士だと
風の噂で聞いたけど。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Monika is but a child, yet she's a formidable soldier!
She would make quite the match for you.
Despite being so young, she's amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ、
モニカさんは子供ですが
軍人でとっても強いデス！
アネゴといい勝負のはず。
子供なのにすごいデース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Y-your guildmaster's a kid? And a soldier?!
Is that even allowed? So many questions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
子供がギルドマスター？　
しかも軍人！？
大丈夫なのか？　
色々と。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I-is she a kid or not? Good grief...
Okay, how about the other members? What are they like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どっちなんだよ
全く……
で、
他のメンバーはどんなやつらなんだい？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Well, Kuka is a masochist, Yuki is a narcissist, and Ayumi is a stalker!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ、
クウカはドMで
ユキはナルシスト、
そしてアユミさんは
ストーカーデス！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on one second.
That series of disturbing descriptions is making my head spin.
...What she says, is any of it true?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっと待っとくれ。
不穏な単語の連続で
頭がこんがらがっちまうよ。
……お前さん、
本当なのかい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's not the answer I was looking for!
text_block_list.orig_text: そこは否定してほしかったねえ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
It's true! Everyone is so peculiar, so Monika always has a tough time.
She doesn't know how to handle them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いかにも！　
みなさんクセ者ばかりなので、
モニカさんも
いつも苦労してマス。
ニンともカンとも。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, don't you think you're a little on the peculiar side yourself?
Don't make out as if you're suffering too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おいおい、
アンタも絶対クセ者の側だろ？
なに困った雰囲気出してんだい。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Hey you, don't you say the same about my guild members?
You sure have a soft spot for girls, don't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん、
ウチの連中にもそう言うだろ？
本当に女の子には甘いねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to tell my whole guild about today's events.
I'll tell Ayumi about climbing the tower with Shogun, and I'll tell Kuka
about the monster that was teasing me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日のことは
ギルドのみんなに
お話しするデス。
アユミさんには
ショーグンと一緒に塔を登ったこと、
クウカには
イジメてくれそうな魔物がいたと
教えてあげマス！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: For Yuki, I'll take something pretty as a souvenir, and for Monika...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユキには
何か
奇麗なモノでもオミヤゲにして、
モニカさんには……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... I completely forgot that today is training day...
I'll get scolded when I return...
And sent to solitary confinement...
text_block_list.orig_text:
オゥ……
今日は訓練の日だって
スッカリ忘れてまシタ……
帰ったら怒られマス……
ザシキロー行きデス……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's a little troublesome, but I don't dislike her.
And a guild with someone like her in it can't be such a bad place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
ちぃと面倒なとこもあるけど、
嫌いじゃないよ。
それに
この子がいるギルドなら、
そう悪いとこじゃないだろうね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Just say Shogun called you up on short notice.
And if need be, I can even settle the matter for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーグンに急遽呼ばれたってことにしときなよ。
なんならアタシが話つけてやってもいいしさ。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: B-Boss Lady... How considerate of you! I appreciate your kindness!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ア、
アネゴ……
おココロ遣い、
感謝しマース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Geez, I guess I have a soft spot too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ、
アタシも甘いね。
